TitleNew Rule Providing Clarity on Definition of IATs Takes Effect Sept. 18
URLhttps://www.nacha.org/news/new-rule-providing-clarity-definition-iats-takes-effect-sept-18
SummaryA change to the Nacha Operating Rules intended to provide greater precision around International ACH Transactions (IATs) takes effect Sept. 18, 2026. The new Rule replaces the existing definition of an IAT to help ACH Network participants more easily determine when an ACH payment should be classified as an IAT.

TitleNew Funds Availability Requirements Take Effect Sept. 18
URLhttps://www.nacha.org/news/new-funds-availability-requirements-take-effect-sept-18
SummaryBeginning Sept. 18, 2026, a change to the Nacha Operating Rules (Nacha Rules) will accelerate funds availability for some non-Same Day ACH credit Entries (i.e., next day and 2-day credits).
